dict.string: AURA needs Accessibility access to control applications and observe UI elements on your behalf. No data leaves your device.
AURA does not use the camera. This key is present only to satisfy App Store validation and is paired with a denied entitlement.
AURA needs microphone access to transcribe commands locally after you activate Push to Talk. Audio is not sent to remote services.
AURA uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your commands. No audio leaves your device.
AURA needs Screen Recording access to understand screen context for computer-use tasks. Captured frames are processed on-device and redacted before any model use.
AURA needs Calendar access to read your agenda when you ask about your schedule. Events are read on-device and are never sent to remote services.
AURA needs Calendar access to read your agenda when you ask about your schedule. Events are read on-device and are never sent to remote services.
AURA needs Contacts access to resolve a name you mention into one contact. Only the matching candidates are read, on-device, and the full address book is never exposed.
